options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task-id {unitree_push_recovery,unitree_stair_climbing}
  --mode {dry-run-audit,live}
  --rounds ROUNDS
  --session-id SESSION_ID
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --session-genesis-dir SESSION_GENESIS_DIR
                        Read an immutable existing Genesis from this directory
                        while writing a fresh ledger epoch under --output-dir.
  --ledger-epoch-id LEDGER_EPOCH_ID
                        Required identity when --session-genesis-dir differs
                        from --output-dir.
  --provider-base-url PROVIDER_BASE_URL
  --provider-endpoint PROVIDER_ENDPOINT
  --provider-model PROVIDER_MODEL
  --provider-api-key-env PROVIDER_API_KEY_ENV
  --provider-env-file PROVIDER_ENV_FILE
  --provider-timeout-s PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_S
  --provider-max-tokens PROVIDER_MAX_TOKENS
  --provider-reasoning-mode {adaptive,disabled,enabled,provider_default}
                        Provider reasoning policy. Adaptive keeps reasoning
                        for new designs and disables it only when retrying a
                        truncated, already-materialized failed draft. When
                        omitted, the official DeepSeek V4 chat endpoint uses
                        adaptive; other OpenAI-compatible endpoints use
                        provider_default.
  --provider-reasoning-effort {high,max}
                        Reasoning intensity for thinking-enabled provider
                        requests. The project default is max; disabled-
                        thinking repairs omit it.
  --provider-max-attempts PROVIDER_MAX_ATTEMPTS
  --isaac-python ISAAC_PYTHON
  --train-entrypoint TRAIN_ENTRYPOINT
  --eval-entrypoint EVAL_ENTRYPOINT
  --execution-device EXECUTION_DEVICE
  --budget-steps BUDGET_STEPS
  --public-seed-count PUBLIC_SEED_COUNT
  --public-accept-seed-count PUBLIC_ACCEPT_SEED_COUNT
  --sealed-validation-seed-count SEALED_VALIDATION_SEED_COUNT, --trusted-seed-count SEALED_VALIDATION_SEED_COUNT
  --eval-protocol-version EVAL_PROTOCOL_VERSION
  --train-seed TRAIN_SEED
  --runtime-config RUNTIME_CONFIG
                        Optional task-owned config override; omitted uses the
                        selected task's bound runtime protocol.
  --train-profile TRAIN_PROFILE
  --eval-profile EVAL_PROFILE
  --train-num-envs TRAIN_NUM_ENVS
  --train-max-iterations TRAIN_MAX_ITERATIONS
  --train-steps-per-iteration TRAIN_STEPS_PER_ITERATION
  --eval-num-envs EVAL_NUM_ENVS
  --runner-timeout-s RUNNER_TIMEOUT_S
  --cell-variant-id {push.g1_29dof.legacy_v1}
  --initial-best-score INITIAL_BEST_SCORE
  --policy-accept-delta POLICY_ACCEPT_DELTA
                        Deprecated compatibility check only; it cannot
                        override the task-owned acceptance protocol.

usage: run_stair_generation_session.py [-h] --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                                       --session-id SESSION_ID
                                       --expected-source-commit
                                       EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT --machine-id
                                       MACHINE_ID --gpu0-uuid GPU0_UUID
                                       --gpu1-uuid GPU1_UUID
                                       --provider-env-file PROVIDER_ENV_FILE
                                       [--lease-root LEASE_ROOT]
                                       --max-allocated-active-gpu-hours
                                       MAX_ALLOCATED_ACTIVE_GPU_HOURS
                                       --max-simulated-control-steps
                                       MAX_SIMULATED_CONTROL_STEPS
                                       --max-output-bytes MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
                                       [--source-reference-genesis-dir SOURCE_REFERENCE_GENESIS_DIR]
                                       [--source-reference-session-id SOURCE_REFERENCE_SESSION_ID]
                                       [--cell-variant-id {stair.g1_37dof.unified_v2,stair.go2_12dof.unified_v2}]
                                       [--nvidia-smi-executable NVIDIA_SMI_EXECUTABLE]
                                       [--pilot-session | --validation-session | --formal-session]
                                       [--pause-after-generation {1,2,3,6,9,12}]
                                       [--terminal-audit-only]
                                       [--resume-existing | --preflight-only | --provider-readiness-only]

Run one frozen dual-GPU Stair pilot, validation, formal session, or a read-
only helper.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --session-id SESSION_ID
  --expected-source-commit EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT
  --machine-id MACHINE_ID
  --gpu0-uuid GPU0_UUID
  --gpu1-uuid GPU1_UUID
  --provider-env-file PROVIDER_ENV_FILE
  --lease-root LEASE_ROOT
  --max-allocated-active-gpu-hours MAX_ALLOCATED_ACTIVE_GPU_HOURS
  --max-simulated-control-steps MAX_SIMULATED_CONTROL_STEPS
  --max-output-bytes MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
  --source-reference-genesis-dir SOURCE_REFERENCE_GENESIS_DIR
                        Import one already-qualified direct reference Genesis
                        without rerunning its reference train/evaluation.
  --source-reference-session-id SOURCE_REFERENCE_SESSION_ID
                        Session id recorded by --source-reference-genesis-dir.
  --cell-variant-id {stair.g1_37dof.unified_v2,stair.go2_12dof.unified_v2}
                        Select the robot row for this Stair generation
                        session.
  --nvidia-smi-executable NVIDIA_SMI_EXECUTABLE
  --pilot-session       Run the fixed one-generation Phase 4 pilot.
  --validation-session  Run the fixed fresh three-generation Phase 4
                        validation.
  --formal-session      Run the fixed 15-generation formal P6-D session;
                        generation count and lifecycle boundaries are not
                        caller-configurable.
  --pause-after-generation {1,2,3,6,9,12}
                        Pause only at a boundary precommitted by the selected
                        session mode.
  --terminal-audit-only
                        Offline-finalize a missing report for an already
                        terminal formal session, or strictly audit its
                        existing report, without new provider/GPU work.
  --resume-existing     Resume the exact existing session/output instead of
                        creating one.
  --preflight-only      Verify source, GPU, credential, and persistence
                        contracts without creating the formal output or
                        starting any session work.
  --provider-readiness-only
                        Check the fixed provider account without creating
                        formal output, starting GPU work, or sending a
                        generation request.

usage: launch_stair_generation_session.py [-h] --python-executable
                                          PYTHON_EXECUTABLE --attempt-dir
                                          ATTEMPT_DIR --timeout-s TIMEOUT_S
                                          [--launch-readiness-receipt LAUNCH_READINESS_RECEIPT]
                                          ...

Launch the tracked Stair generation entrypoint with one immutable attempt
directory and exit receipt per physical attempt.

positional arguments:
  generation_args

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --python-executable PYTHON_EXECUTABLE
  --attempt-dir ATTEMPT_DIR
  --timeout-s TIMEOUT_S
  --launch-readiness-receipt LAUNCH_READINESS_RECEIPT
                        Required for a fresh formal generation. The immutable
                        receipt must bind this source, host, output, session,
                        GPU pair, lease root, and output cap before an attempt
                        directory or child process is created.
